buildings.name: Hanging Trap
buildings.description:
Trap that catches Pals passing through it.
Pals caught in the trap are easier to catch with Spheres.
Only effective on small Pals.

buildings.name: Bear Trap (Small)
buildings.description: Trap that immobilizes Pals who step on it. The capture rate with the sphere increases when a Pal is trapped. Only effective on small Pals.

buildings.name: Bear Trap (Large)
buildings.description: A bear trap to immobilize large Pals. The capture rate with the sphere increases when a Pal is trapped. Only effective on large Pals, small Pals will not be caught.

buildings.name: Mine
buildings.description: Trap that explodes when a Pal steps on it. It deals damage to a wide area.

buildings.name: Electric Mine
buildings.description: Trap that electrocutes the Pal that steps on it. The electrocuted Pal has a higher capture rate with the sphere.

buildings.name: Ice Mine
buildings.description: Trap that freezes the Pal that steps on it. The frozen Pal has a higher capture rate with the sphere.

buildings.name: Sandbag
buildings.description:
A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies.
When a Pal is assigned, it will stop other work and stay on lookout and prepare for combat.

buildings.name: Mounted Crossbow
buildings.description:
A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies.
When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a crossbow.

buildings.name: Mounted Machine Gun
buildings.description:
A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies.
When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a machine gun.

buildings.name: Mounted Missile Launcher
buildings.description:
A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies.
When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a missile launcher.

buildings.name: Ancient Turret
buildings.description:
An unmanned turret of ancient technology equipped with rocket launcher–level size and firepower.
It requires no ammunition or Pal assignment, and performs fully automated interception using only electricity.
However, despite its immense power, it requires a massive amount of electricity to operate.

buildings.name: Alarm Bell
buildings.description:
Bell that sets the alert status for Pals on base.
Change Pal behavior to either attack invading enemies, or focus entirely on work whenever you like.

buildings.name: Wooden Defensive Wall
buildings.description:
Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions.
Made from wood, it breaks easily.

buildings.name: Stone Defensive Wall
buildings.description:
Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions.
Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

buildings.name: Metal Defensive Wall
buildings.description:

Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

buildings.name: Wooden Gate
buildings.description:
Gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.
Made from wood, it breaks easily.

buildings.name: Stone Gate
buildings.description:

buildings.name: Campfire
buildings.description:
Needed for cooking food.
It can only be used to grill simple ingredients.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Cooking Pot
buildings.description:
Needed for cooking food.
Use of a cooking pot allows for a wider variety of meal preparation.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Electric Kitchen
buildings.description:
Needed for cooking food.
It requires electricity to run, but allows a large amount of meals to be prepared rapidly.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Large-Scale Stone Oven
buildings.description:
Needed for cooking food.
By becoming larger, multiple Pals can cooperate to cook together.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Ancient Kitchen
buildings.description:
A special kitchen based on ancient technology that can create everything from existing dishes to entirely new recipes.
It retains heat through fire and completes cooking with manual preparation, allowing it to prepare any kind of cuisine.
It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Handiwork suitability.

buildings.name: Feed Box
buildings.description:
A box for storing Pal food.
Pals can feed from it when hungry.
Make sure to keep it well-stocked to keep your Pals happy.

buildings.name: Cold Food Box
buildings.description:
A feeding box that can be kept cold.
Assign an Ice Pal to it and
the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

buildings.name: Berry Plantation
buildings.description:
A farm that can grow Red Berries.
Harvest time is quick, but eating them doesn't provide much sustenance.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

buildings.name: Wheat Plantation
buildings.description:
A farm that can grow Wheat.
It requires an average amount of time to harvest.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest crops.

buildings.name: Tomato Plantation
buildings.description:
A farm that can grow Tomato.
They take time to harvest, but increase the variety of meals you can prepare.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

buildings.name: Lettuce Plantation
buildings.description:
A farm that can grow Lettuce.
It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

buildings.name: Potato Plantation
buildings.description:
A farm where you can grow Potato.
It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

buildings.name: Carrot Plantation
buildings.description:
A farm where you can grow Carrot.
It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

buildings.name: Onion Plantation
buildings.description:
A farm where you can grow Onion.
It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

buildings.name: Skillfruit Orchard
buildings.description:
A farm where Skillfruits can be cultivated.
By planting the original fruit in the ground,
multiple fruits of the same type can be harvested.

buildings.name: Ancient Farm
buildings.description:
A special cultivation device based on ancient technology that harnesses the power of the World Tree to grow all kinds of plants on Palpagos Island.
Smaller than a berry plantation and suitable for indoor placement, it still follows the same cultivation process as standard plots.
It requires Pals with high-level Planting, Watering, and Harvesting suitability.

buildings.name: Shoddy Bed
buildings.description:
A shoddy bed for humans.
Use it when injured or to sleep at night.
You won't be able to sleep soundly without a roof over your head.

buildings.name: Fine Bed
buildings.description:
A fluffy bed for humans.
Use it when injured or to sleep at night.
You won't be able to sleep soundly without a roof over your head.

buildings.name: Straw Pal Bed
buildings.description:
A straw bed for Pals.
Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night.
It isn't soft, but it's better than nothing.

buildings.name: Fluffy Pal Bed
buildings.description:
A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on.
Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night.
Pals love sleeping on fluffy beds like this.

buildings.name: Large Pal Bed
buildings.description:
A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on.
Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night.
Even large Pals can sleep soundly on a bed like this.

buildings.name: Pal Pod
buildings.description:
A healing pod for Pals.
Used when Pals are injured or to rest at night.
Thanks to technological advancements, the healing amount has increased.

buildings.name: Ancient Pal Bed
buildings.description:
A ulitmate Pal Bed made from ancient recovery pod with soft matress.
It offers one of the highest SAN recovery rates of all Pal beds, quickly relieving fatigue.
It is the same size as a Large Pal Bed, allowing large Pals to rest comfortably.

buildings.name: Human-Powered Generator
buildings.description:
A facility that converts rotational motion into electrical energy.
The efficiency is low, and the Pals working here will experience a decrease in SAN value, but they will gain experience points.

buildings.name: Power Generator
buildings.description:
A power generator fueled by Electric Pals.
Electric equipment won't run without this.

buildings.name: Large Power Generator
buildings.description:
A power generator fueled by Electric Pals.
Larger and with improved power generation efficiency.

buildings.name: Ancient Power Generator
buildings.description:
A highly efficient power generator restored from lost ancient technology.
It produces massive amounts of electricity, but is prone to overheating while in operation.
It requires Pals with high-level Generating Electricity and any level of Watering suitability.

buildings.name: Accumulator
buildings.description: A facility for storing excess electricity generated by the Power Generator.

buildings.name: Heater
buildings.description:
A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base.
It doesn't provide much warmth, but helps one to endure somewhat cold environments.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Cooler
buildings.description:
A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base.
It doesn't provide much relief from the heat, but helps one to endure somewhat hot environments.
Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

buildings.name: Electric Heater
buildings.description:
A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base.
Using electricity, it can really heat things up.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Electric Cooler
buildings.description:
A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base.
Using electricity, it can really lower the temperature.
Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

buildings.name: Hot Spring
buildings.description:
Facility where Pals on base can rest.
Restores SAN after a long day of hard work.

buildings.name: High Quality Hot Spring
buildings.description:
Facility where Pals on base can rest.
Now comfier and restores more SAN.

buildings.name: Japanese-Style Hot Spring
buildings.description:
Facility where Pals on base can rest.
Its calming, traditional Japanese design offers an extra boost to SAN recovery.

buildings.name: Ancient Hot Spring
buildings.description:
A hot spring built with ancient technology, filled with special water infused with Paldium.
It offers the highest SAN recovery of all hot springs and also restores Health.
It is the same size as a standard hot spring, and can fully heal injured Pals.

buildings.name: Clinic
buildings.description:
A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base.
Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury.
While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

buildings.name: Ancient Clinic
buildings.description:
A top-tier medical facility that reproduces advanced ancient medical technology.
It offers significantly greater protective capability than a standard clinic.
By assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability, even bases with harsh working conditions can maintain the highest level of hygiene.

buildings.name: Medicine Rack
buildings.description: A shelf for storing medicine. Sick Pals will come here to take their medicine. Be sure to keep the medicine stocked.

buildings.description:
A gravestone that can be inscribed with text.
Use it for recording purposes.

buildings.name: Palbox
buildings.description:
Facility for storing captured Pals.
Pals inside gradually recover Health.
Area around this facility becomes a base.

buildings.name: Global Palbox
buildings.description:
A facility that can store the genetic data of Pals
and allows you to reconstruct them from this data.
The stored genetic data can also be transferred to other worlds.

buildings.name: Dimensional Pal Storage
buildings.description:
A facility for storing a large number of captured Pals.
Any guild member can deposit or withdraw Pals.
If you set it to private, it can serve as your personal Pal storage.

buildings.name: Palbox Control Device
buildings.description:
A remote-access terminal for the Palbox.
Set it up wherever you'd like and build a base of your own design.

buildings.name: Monitoring Stand
buildings.description:
Command your Pals to work on various things inside a base.
You can allow or prohibit individual kinds of work.

buildings.name: High Quality Monitoring Stand
buildings.description:
A refined monitoring station with improved materials and structure.
In addition to being able to issue work orders, the system also lowers the SAN cost for Pals working at the base.
Working conditions are slightly improved, making Pals less likely to become dissatisfied.

buildings.name: Ancient Monitoring Stand
buildings.description:
A monitoring station based on ancient technology, embedded with Red Paldium.
It issues commands across the entire base through a holographic interface, reducing SAN depletion in Pals.
A special wavelength surrounds the base, keeping Pals calm even in harsh working environments.

buildings.name: Pal Labor Research Lab
buildings.description:
A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals.
By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.

buildings.name: Pal Expedition Station
buildings.description:
A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons.
The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.

buildings.name: Statue of Power
buildings.description:
Stone statue spoken of in legends on Palpagos Island.
Offer up Lifmunk Effigy to receive strange powers.

buildings.name: Pal Essence Condenser
buildings.description:
A chamber for increasing a Pal's rank.
Pals can surpass their physical limitations if given
a concentrated extract taken from a Pal of the same type.

buildings.name: Pal Surgery Table
buildings.description: A facility where surgery can be performed on Pals to change their gender or passive skills.

buildings.name: Breeding Farm
buildings.description:
Assign one male and one female Pal to produce eggs.
Placing Cake in the facility is required for production.

buildings.name: Ranch
buildings.description:
Farm for raising sheep and fowl-like Pals.
Assign a Pal with the appropriate Partner Skill to a farm
to produce items.

buildings.name: Egg Incubator
buildings.description:
Used for incubating a Pal Egg.
If a Pal Egg is left in it, it will automatically hatch after some time has passed.

buildings.name: Electric Egg Incubator
buildings.description:
Device for incubating Pal eggs.
Requires electricity, but automatically keeps the
inside of the incubator at appropriate temperatures.

buildings.name: Large Incubator
buildings.description:
Device for incubating Pal eggs.
It automatically maintains a suitable temperature and can hatch multiple eggs at once.

buildings.name: Large-Scale Electric Egg Incubator
buildings.description:
Device for incubating Pal eggs.
While power supply is required, it allows multiple eggs to be incubated simultaneously at the optimal temperature.

buildings.name: Ancient Hatchery
buildings.description:
An advanced breeding facility of ancient civilization technology, enclosed in electronic glass.
It fully automates everything from egg production to incubation at high speed, and increases the inheritance rate of rare skills.
Pals are managed through holograms, it requires minimal pasture space.

buildings.name: Pal Dressing Facility
buildings.description:
Pal Dressing Facility.
Give your Pals a new look!
Skins obtained inside and outside the game can be applied here!

buildings.name: Viewing Cage
buildings.description:
Container for observing captured Pals.
Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production,
but they do not become hungry.

buildings.name: Pal Disassembly Conveyor
buildings.description: A dream-like facility that automatically butchers any Pal that is placed inside.

buildings.name: Summoning Altar
buildings.description:
Offer a Slab depicting a Pal
to summon a powerful Pal to your base.
Adequate caution and battle readiness is paramount.

buildings.name: Primitive Workbench
buildings.description:
A Primitive Workbench for producing simple items.
Requires a Pal that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Repair Bench
buildings.description:
Workbench for repairing broken tools.
Materials are needed to make repairs.

buildings.name: Pal Gear Workbench
buildings.description:
A Primitive Workbench for producing Pal tools.
Make a saddle to ride Pals, or make a gun for Pals to use.

buildings.name: High-Quality Workbench
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing items and gear.
A small workspace limits production speeds.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Production Assembly Line
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing items and gear.
By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Production Assembly Line II
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing items and gear.
Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Advanced Workshop
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing items and gear.
Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed production.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Ancient Workbench
buildings.description:
A Pal-exclusive workbench that is capable of crafting any item in one place.
It cannot be used by the player, and operates at the same speed as a regular workbench.
Due to its advanced equipment, it requires Pals with high-level Handiwork and Medicine Production suitability.

buildings.name: Drafting Table
buildings.description: A facility that lets you combine multiple schematics to create more advanced ones.

buildings.name: Gold Coin Assembly Line
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line that manufactures Gold Coin.
The work puts a strain on the mind, causing a decrease in Pal's SAN value.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
Warning: building this facility may draw severe scrutiny from the PIDF.

buildings.name: Ancient Relic Recycler
buildings.description:
An ancient civilization device that converts materials using repurposed technology from a lost civilization.
It deciphers the technology left within Ancient Relics and refines them into new forms.
A highly specialized facility designed for the efficient use of relics without waste.

buildings.name: Sphere Workbench
buildings.description:
A Primitive Workbench for producing spheres used for capturing Pals.
A small workspace keeps the production speed slow.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Sphere Assembly Line
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals.
By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Sphere Assembly Line II
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals.
Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Advanced Sphere Assembly Line
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals.
Advanced machinery has been introduced, allowing for the production of spheres at high speed.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Weapon Workbench
buildings.description:
A Primitive Workbench for producing weapons and ammunition.
A small workspace prevents the production of high quality weapons.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Weapon Assembly Line
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition.
By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Weapon Assembly Line II
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition.
Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Advanced Weapon Assembly Line
buildings.description:
An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition.
Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed weapon production.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Logging Site
buildings.description:
A facility for producing Wood.
Cutting wood is hard work that requires much physical endurance.
Leave it to Pals skilled in logging.

buildings.name: Logging Site II
buildings.description:
Facility for producing Hardwood.
Cutting wood is hard work that requires much physical endurance.
Leave it to Pals skilled in logging.

buildings.name: Stone Pit
buildings.description:
A facility for producing Stone.
Mining Stone is hard work that requires much physical endurance.
Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

buildings.name: Ore Mining Site
buildings.description:
Facility for producing Ore.
Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance.
Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

buildings.name: Ore Mining Site II
buildings.description:
Facility for producing large quantities of Ore.
Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance.
Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

buildings.name: Coal Quarry
buildings.description:
Facility for producing Coal.
Digging Coal is grueling physical work.
Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

buildings.name: Sulfur Quarry
buildings.description:
Facility for producing Sulfur.
Digging Sulfur is grueling physical work.
Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

buildings.name: Pure Quartz Quarry
buildings.description:
A facility for producing Pure Quartz.
Mining Pure Quartz is grueling physical work.
Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

buildings.name: Crude Oil Extractor
buildings.description:
Equipment required to extract Crude Oil from oil fields.
Requires a power supply to operate.

buildings.name: High-Pressure Crude Oil Extractor
buildings.description:
A device that pumps and extracts Crude Oil from deep underground.
It can produce Crude Oil even in areas without oil fields, but it can only be placed on open ground with no structures beneath it.
It requires a far greater supply of electricity than the Crude Oil Extractor.

buildings.name: Hexolite Quartz Mine
buildings.description:
Facility for producing Hexolite Quartzs.
Digging Hexolite Quartzs is grueling physical work.
Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

buildings.name: Soralite Quarry
buildings.description:
Facility for producing Soralite.
Digging Soralite is grueling physical work.
Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

buildings.name: Ancient Material Synthesizer
buildings.description:
A special generator based on ancient technology that uses the power of the World Tree to produce all kinds of wood and ore.
Due to its complex structure, only one Pal can be assigned to it.

buildings.name: Primitive Furnace
buildings.description:
Allows refinement of Ingot.
The quality leaves much to desire, and processing is slow.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Improved Furnace
buildings.description:
Allows refinement of Refined Ingot.
The quality has improved, but the processing speed is still unsatisfactory.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Electric Furnace
buildings.description:
Allows refinement of Pal Metal Ingot.
It requires electricity to use, but is quicker to process.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Gigantic Furnace
buildings.description:
Allows refinement of Hexolite.
By growing in size, multiple Pals can collaborate to perform smelting.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Ancient Furnace
buildings.description:
A special furnace based on ancient technology that can smelt all types of ingots.
Materials are melted with fire, then quickly cooled and solidified using ice.
It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Cooling suitability.

buildings.name: Mill
buildings.description:
Facility for milling Wheat to produce Flour.
Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

buildings.name: Crusher
buildings.description:
Facility for breaking down Stone and Wood to exchange them for other materials.
Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

buildings.name: Cryogenic Crusher
buildings.description:
Facility that crushes Ore and
converts it into other materials.
Requires a power supply and a Pal with Cooling suitability, but it's very efficient.

buildings.name: Medieval Medicine Workbench
buildings.description:
A facility for making Pal medicine.
It can only produce simple medicines.
Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.

buildings.name: Electric Medicine Workbench
buildings.description:
A facility for making Pal medicine.
It requires electricity, but can produce high quality medicine.
Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.

buildings.name: Advanced Medicine Workbench
buildings.description:
A facility for making medicine to cure Pals' illnesses.
With advanced technology, it can also create unknown medicines.
Assign the task to a Pal capable of pharmacy work.

buildings.name: Fishing Pond
buildings.description:
A ready-to-use fishing pond.
Assign a Pal to fish here at their own leisure.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Large Fishing Pond
buildings.description:
A ready-to-use large fishing pond.
The expanded body of water makes it possible to catch even larger Pals.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Wooden Chest
buildings.description:
Stores items.
Made from wood, it breaks easily.
It's probably not the best thing to store valuables in.

buildings.name: Metal Chest
buildings.description:
Stores items.
Reinforced with metal, it is somewhat durable.
The increased size allows for the storage of more things.

buildings.name: Refined Metal Chest
buildings.description:
Stores items.
Made of iron, it is extremely durable.
It is useful as a large, secure storage box.

buildings.name: Cooler Box
buildings.description:
Small food vault.
Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent
food stored inside from spoiling.

buildings.name: Refrigerator
buildings.description:
Large food vault.
Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent
food stored inside from spoiling.

buildings.name: Guild Chest
buildings.description:
A chest that can instantly send and receive items through subspace.
The items inside are shared across all bases where it is placed.

buildings.name: Item Retrieval Machine
buildings.description: A device that lets you freely access items from all chests in the base.

buildings.name: Advanced Chest
buildings.description:
Stores items.
Quite sturdy, with plenty of storage space.
It is useful as a large, secure storage box.

buildings.name: Wooden Box
buildings.description: Wooden box for storing items.

buildings.name: Wooden Barrel
buildings.description: Wooden barrel for storing items.

buildings.name: Wooden Shelf
buildings.description: Wooden shelf for storing items.

buildings.name: Wooden Barrel Shelf
buildings.description: Wooden barrel shelf for storing items.

buildings.name: Wooden Wall Shelf
buildings.description:
Wooden shelf for storing items.
Can be placed on a wall.

buildings.name: Antique Bookshelf
buildings.description: Antique bookshelf for storing items.

buildings.name: Antique Wardrobe
buildings.description: Antique wardrobe for storing items.

buildings.name: Antique Chest
buildings.description:
Antique chest for storing items.
Adorned with a photo of a Pal.

buildings.name: Antique Side Chest
buildings.description:
Antique side chest for storing items.
Adorned with a photo of a Pal.

buildings.name: Antique Cabinet
buildings.description: Antique cabinet for storing items.

buildings.name: Antique Long Cabinet
buildings.description:
Antique long cabinet for storing items.
Adorned with a photo of a Pal.

buildings.name: Large Antique Cabinet
buildings.description: Large antique cabinet for storing items.

buildings.name: Antique Wall Cabinet
buildings.description:
Antique cabinet for storing items.
Can be placed on walls.

buildings.name: Iron Shelf
buildings.description: Iron shelf for storing items.

buildings.name: Long Iron Shelf
buildings.description: Long iron shelf for storing items.

buildings.name: Iron Wall Shelf
buildings.description:
Iron wall shelf for storing items.
Can be placed on a wall.

buildings.name: Orange Locker
buildings.description:
Orange locker for storing items.
Decorated with Pal stickers.

buildings.name: Locker
buildings.description:
Locker for storing items.
Decorated with Pal stickers.

buildings.name: Large Container
buildings.description:
Large container for storing items.
Imitates the designs left behind by an ancient and prosperous civilization.

buildings.name: Small Container
buildings.description: Small container for storing items.

buildings.name: Cloth Covered Container
buildings.description: Cloth covered container for storing items.

buildings.name: Japanese-Style Chest
buildings.description:
Stores items.
Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

FireCultFlagSet.name: Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Flag Set

ScientistFlagSet.name: PAL Genetic Research Unit Flag Set
